notes.title: You Arrive In A Town - 1 Year On
notes.content:
Hey folks!

To help celebrate the upcoming 1 year anniversary of You Arrive In A Town, we've put together a batch of tweaks and changes to help fix some existing issues while also including some new QOL changes and visual overhauls.

Patch 1.0.8

 Rebalanced first chapter level difficulties
 Increased player character turn and move speed
 Added visuals to show when a new enemy wave spawns
 Added see through effect when player characters are hidden behind objects
 Added 2 new achievements and tweaked certain existing ones
 Updated intro screen and menu interface
 Tweaked and improved enemy spawning effects
 Added further menu sounds to improve feedback
 Improved tutorial level geometry
 General UI visual improvements
 General texture and sprite improvements
 General lighting and shadows improvements
 File optimisation


In addition to these changes we're also lowering the base price of the game so you can experience the world of YAIAT for less!

A lot has changed since we first released You Arrive In A Town on Steam last January. Myself, Joe, and Andrew have been busy making our own first steps into the world of game development professionally. We'd like to thank everybody for your, advice, support, and feedback over this last year and, hopefully, we'll see you all around again in the future.

All the best,

Dan, Joe, and Andrew.

notes.title: YAIAT 1.0.7 is now live
notes.content:
Just a small hotfix patch to help with some quality of life issues.


 Physics should now be normalised across all types of computer. Some items/elements of the game will now feel weaker or stronger to be in line with the original intention.

 VSync will now be on by default to reduce screen tearing. You can toggle this off in the main menu if you so desire.

Thanks as ever for supporting us and our game, and if you have any suggestions, criticisms or ideas, feel free to mention them here and we'll do our best to act on them!

notes.title: Physics Hotfix
notes.content: Don't worry about it, absolutely nothing went wrong.

notes.title: Quick Update - 1.0.1
notes.content:
We've got plans in the works for YAIAT post-launch as a thank you for everyone who picked up a copy, but for now here's a little update to squeeze in a couple of things we didn't have time for in the 1.0 release.

New table and chairs!
Level flags to mark your progress.
Rebalance of the early levels for a smoother difficulty curve.
Visual tweaks and fixes.

We hope you're enjoying the game! Let us know in the Steam community forum or through our Twitter (@BunnyBoxGames) what you'd want to see in future!
